title: theme: sequence diagram 的 highlight outline 沒有任何樣式（只有 glow 看得見）

v:
撰寫 `skills/siren` 時查證 highlight 效果發現。

## 事實

`theme/default.css` 的 `.siren-highlight-outline` 規則逐一列舉目標（`.siren-node`、`.siren-edge`、`.siren-subgraph`、`.siren-class`、`.siren-relationship`、`.siren-namespace`、`.siren-note`、ER 三種、`.siren-state`、`.siren-transition`），**沒有任何 sequence diagram 的類別**：`.siren-participant`、`.siren-message`、`.siren-block`、`.siren-box`、`.siren-activation-bar` 都不在內。

`glow` 有一條不分目標的 `.siren-highlight-glow { filter: drop-shadow(...) }`，所以 sequence 的 glow 看得見；`outline` 會掛上 class，但畫面上什麼都不變。

**repo 自己的 `examples/sequence-full.srn` 就寫了 `highlight loop:1 outline` 與 `highlight rect:1 outline`**——這兩步在 demo 裡等於沒有動作，而沒有任何東西報錯。

## 修法方向

為 sequence 的各目標補上 outline 規則，比照其他圖表：外框/線條換成 `--siren-highlight-color`、加粗到 `--siren-highlight-stroke-width`。同時確認 glow 的「stroke 換色」規則（見 `37ea2c5`）是否也該涵蓋 sequence。

`rect` 沒有外框（CONTEXT.md：filled background, no frame），要決定它的 outline 畫在哪裡。

## 驗收

- 每種 sequence 目標在 outline 下有看得見的變化；加測試讀 CSS 規則的涵蓋範圍，比照 `default.test.ts` 既有的做法。
- `skills/siren/SKILL.md` 的「In sequence diagrams only `glow` is visible」一句移除。

## 驗證指令

- `pnpm --filter siren-core test`

# 02 `outline` is visible on every sequence-diagram target

nook: 01M3NK0C6SN2Z0BHDWM2RNWRVW

## Outcome

`highlight X outline` changes the picture for participants, messages, blocks (including
`rect`), boxes and activation bars, in both light and dark palettes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With the default theme injected, adding `siren-highlight-outline` to each sequence
      target's id-carrying element changes the computed `stroke` of its stroked element(s) to
      `var(--siren-highlight-color)` and `stroke-width` to
      `var(--siren-highlight-stroke-width)`:
  - participant: the participant-row `rect` (box) / actor figure `circle` and `line`s, the
    `siren-lifeline`, and the `siren-destroy-mark`; the lifeline keeps its dash;
  - message: `siren-message-arrow` (arrowhead markers unchanged);
  - block: `siren-block-frame` and `siren-block-divider`;
  - `rect` block: `siren-block-fill` gains the highlight stroke (it has none before);
  - box: `siren-box-background`; activation bar: `siren-activation-bar`.
- [ ] Removing the class restores the previous computed stroke.
- [ ] The rules follow the file's existing outline pattern (transition on stroke and
      stroke-width, `--siren-highlight-duration`) and sit with the other outline rules.
- [ ] `glow` behavior is unchanged; if the glow "stroke recolor" rule (commit 37ea2c5) is
      extended to sequence targets for consistency, it is tested the same way.
- [ ] skills/siren/SKILL.md: remove "In sequence diagrams only `glow` is visible at the
      moment: `outline` is accepted but draws nothing."
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` → Fixed.

## Test seam

Default theme through `render()` + `getComputedStyle`, the pattern of
`packages/core/src/theme/default.test.ts` ("still gives a highlighted node the outline effect").
